title: Bram and the Ledger
author: Ansel Fairweather
blurb: Gideon Galloway, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
